summary: Rocket One Inc. filed Amendment No. 1 to a prospectus supplement (424B5) to increase the amount of common stock it may sell under an existing at-the-market offering (Sales Agreement dated Nov 8, 2024 with H.C. Wainwright). The amendment adds up to $2.66 million in shares (at $1.36/share as of May 27, 2026), bringing total gross proceeds under the agreement to ~$9.3 million. The filing is a routine shelf takedown update under Rule 424(b)(5) to comply with Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 limits. No special-situation dynamics—no acquisition, activist, tender, or restructuring. Watch for dilution risk and Nasdaq compliance given small market cap.
